questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are only for buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pavement becomes slippery when wet. Slow down and increase your following distance. Avoid sudden braking or sharp direction changes in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means an action is prohibited. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used instead of or along with turn signals. A left arm bent at the elbow and pointing upward means the operator is turning right or moving right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells drivers what they must do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that a school zone is coming up. Reduce your speed and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign tells you to slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points down, it means the driver is slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. Always slow down if weather or road conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic signal, red is always on top and green is on the bottom. On a horizontal signal, red is always on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow background. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Be ready to adjust your speed to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow background. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you the divided highway is about to end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs have yellow background with black text. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to safely pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead will be divided by a median or divider. Stay to the right side of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs have yellow background with black text. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red light and watch for crossing traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is approaching and you should be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.
